title: MaxMulSK: FP32 GEMM for Apple M4 (MaxMulSK Trio and v5.1)
description:
MaxMulSK is an FP32 GEMM (matrix multiplication) library for the Apple M4, written against Arm SME/SME2. MaxMulSK Trio is a multi-threaded kernel: one SME thread that only computes, fed by two NEON threads through L2 rings. MaxMulSK v5.1 is the single-thread fused-pack kernel it is built on.
